header:
import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
noncomputable def dividedPower (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] V) (r : ℕ) : V →ₗ[ℂ] V := ((Nat.factorial r : ℂ)⁻¹) • (f ^ r)
noncomputable def tensorAction {K : Type*} [Field K] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M] (f : M →ₗ[ℤ] M) : K ⊗[ℤ] M →ₗ[K] K ⊗[ℤ] M := TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor K K f
def InvariantUnder (K : Type*) [Field K] (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module K E] (f : E →ₗ[K] E) (W : Submodule K E) : Prop := ∀ z ∈ W, f z ∈ W
def LieIrreducible (K : Type*) [Field K] (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module K E] (x y z : E →ₗ[K] E) : Prop := Nontrivial E ∧ ∀ W : Submodule K E, InvariantUnder K E x W → InvariantUnder K E y W → InvariantUnder K E z W → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
structure LieLatticeData (lam : ℤ) (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M] where
  V : Type
  [vAdd : AddCommGroup V]
  [vMod : Module ℂ V]
  basisV : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℂ V
  basisM : Module.Basis (Fin (lam.toNat + 1)) ℤ M
  embed : M →ₗ[ℤ] V
  x : V →ₗ[ℂ] V
  y : V →ₗ[ℂ] V
  z : V →ₗ[ℂ] V
  xM : M →ₗ[ℤ] M
  yM : M →ₗ[ℤ] M
  zM : M →ₗ[ℤ] M
  v : V
def LieLatticeData.H004 {lam : ℤ} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M] (D : LieLatticeData lam M) : Prop := by
  letI := D.vAdd
  letI := D.vMod
  exact (∀ i, D.basisV i = D.embed (D.basisM i)) ∧ Function.Injective D.embed ∧
    (∀ w, D.z (D.x w) - D.x (D.z w) = (2:ℂ) • D.x w) ∧
    (∀ w, D.z (D.y w) - D.y (D.z w) = (-2:ℂ) • D.y w) ∧
    (∀ w, D.x (D.y w) - D.y (D.x w) = D.z w) ∧ D.v ≠ 0 ∧ D.x D.v = 0 ∧ D.z D.v = (lam:ℂ) • D.v ∧
    (∀ m, D.embed (D.xM m) = D.x (D.embed m)) ∧ (∀ m, D.embed (D.yM m) = D.y (D.embed m)) ∧
    (∀ m, D.embed (D.zM m) = D.z (D.embed m)) ∧
    (∀ r m, ∃ m', D.embed m' = dividedPower D.V D.x r (D.embed m)) ∧
    (∀ r m, ∃ m', D.embed m' = dividedPower D.V D.y r (D.embed m)) ∧
    LieIrreducible ℂ D.V D.x D.y D.z
conclusion_type: LieIrreducible K (K ⊗[ℤ] M) (tensorAction D.xM) (tensorAction D.yM) (tensorAction D.zM)
representation: The arbitrary free lattice is M with a Z-basis and an injective inclusion into the complex highest-weight module V. The data record carries the actual complex operators and their integral restrictions. Scalar extension is represented by K tensor_Z M, with K acting on the first factor; this is related to the source ordering M tensor_Z K by the tensor commutor, which must be proved/used as a conversion. The target predicate means nonzero and every K-subspace invariant under all three induced actions is zero or the whole space. This is not a standard-lattice specialization.

steps.statement: LieIrreducible K (K ⊗[ℤ] M) (tensorAction D.xM) (tensorAction D.yM) (tensorAction D.zM)
steps.explanation: Single assembled obligation preserving the NL0 route: establish the divided-power basis and termination (S001), construct and preserve matrix units including the composite coefficient computation and p=2/lambda=0 cases (S002), analyze the arbitrary lattice coordinate modules and rank-one generator without presupposing freeness (S003), reduce via the arbitrary lattice basis to M tensor K and transport x,y,h (S004), show matrix units survive since r! and binomial coefficients are units for lambda
